title: Fix 'fatal: not a git repository' by entering or creating a project
summary: Git works only inside a project folder that has a hidden .git folder. This error means the folder you are in, and no folder above it, is not a git repository. Go into your project folder, or create a repository in it.

error_patterns: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

steps.explain: Show the folder you are in. Git looks for a .git folder here and in the folders above it.
steps.expect: A full path such as /home/user/Documents, the folder you are in.

steps.explain: List all files, including hidden ones. A project folder that is a repository contains a .git entry. If you see only ordinary files, this folder is not a repository.
steps.expect: A list starting with . and .. . A .git entry appears only inside a repository.

steps.explain: Ask git whether a folder above this one is a repository. If one is found, git prints its top folder. If none is found, git prints the error.
steps.expect: Either the path of the repository top folder, or 'fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git'.

steps.explain: Go into the project folder, the one that holds the .git folder. Use a folder name from your own list of folders.

placeholders.name: PROJECT_DIR
placeholders.description: Path to the project folder that contains the .git folder

steps.expect: No output. Run pwd again to confirm the folder changed.

alternatives.explain: The folder is a new project with no repository yet: create one in the current folder. Do not do this in your home folder.
alternatives.expect: Creates a hidden .git folder and prints 'Initialized empty Git repository in ...'.

alternatives.explain: The project is stored online: download a copy of it into a new folder. Git creates a folder named after the project, so run cd into it afterwards.

placeholders.name: REPO_URL
placeholders.description: Address of the repository, for example from the Clone button on the website

alternatives.expect: Prints 'Cloning into ...' and creates a new folder with the project files.

steps.explain: Check that git now works in this folder. A repository prints its branch.
steps.expect: A line starting with 'On branch' and no 'fatal:' line. A new repository also prints 'No commits yet'.

warnings: Do not run git init in your home folder: git would then track all your files in one repository.

verify.expect: Prints 'true' when you are inside a repository.
